title: Sparks of Tomorrow
description: In an alternate past, an unlikely duo team up to look for a missing catalog that could bring electricity to the smoke-filled streets of Kyoto.

episodes_data.title: Sparks of Tomorrow Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Early 20th-century Kyoto. Kihachi witnesses the wonders of electricity with Seiroku. Four years later, alone and cynical, he meets a girl deep in prayer.

episodes_data.title: Sparks of Tomorrow Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: In a haze of incense, Yosuke storms into Kihachi's workshop and demands the Catalog — and his fiancée. But why does Inako have it in the first place?

episodes_data.title: Sparks of Tomorrow Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Full of denial, Yosuke clashes with Kihachi. Later, Inako's sharp senses reveal a secret and her belief inspires Kihachi to recreate an invention.
